Courage insaan ki pehli quality hai, kyunki yahi baaki sabko guarantee karti hai.
Grit matlab apna waada nibhana.
Fortitude endurance ke saath courage hai.
Himmat sona hai.
Waqt ke saath mushkil bhi possible.
Himmat hai fear ko chhodne ki power.
Himmat zindagi ka fuel hai.
Khamoshi aaram hai.
Bahaduri bhare kaam aatma ko darshate hain.
Bahadur jaante hain woh darte hain.
Grit long game hai.
Chup rehna woh canvas hai jahan buddhi rang bhar deti hai.
Grit mind ko train karta.
Kriya darr ko theek karti.
Bahadur woh nahi jo fear feel na kare.
Grit woh hai jo jaane se aasaan hone par bhi ruk jaye.
Khamoshi humein apne vicharon ko sunne ki jagah deti hai.
Khamoshi samajh ka jawaab hai.
Yeh maayne nahi rakhta ki aap kitna dheere chal rahe hain, bas rukna mat.
